item.title: Trump invites teen lifeguard Ryder Williams to White House after heroic beach rescue
item.description: President Donald Trump has invited 16-year-old California lifeguard Ryder Williams and his family to the White House after the teenager rescued a young boy from powerful waves at Seabright State Beach. Trump said Williams deserves a high civilian honour for his bravery. The dramatic rescue, captured on video, has drawn widespread praise from officials, witnesses and social media users, with many calling the rookie lifeguard a true hero

item.title: What happened between Kai Cenat and Tyla? Inside the viral Disney World photo booth moment
item.description: Kai Cenat and Tyla reunited for a Disney World livestream after more than two years, but an unexpected photo booth moment became the biggest talking point. When Kai closed the curtain, Tyla immediately pulled it back open, leaving viewers with different interpretations. Kai later explained he was simply following normal photo booth etiquette, while fans debated everything from practical reasons to their long-running friend-zone meme.

item.title: Quote of the day by Clint Eastwood: "You have to steal a lot. You have to have a criminal mentality to be a…" - a fascinating lesson on creativity, influence and originality
item.description: Clint Eastwood suggests directors must absorb many influences to create original work. This involves studying techniques and styles from others, then adapting them. Real inspiration means transforming principles into something distinctly your own. Curiosity and personal perspective are key to genuine creative output. Experienced professionals continuously learn and build upon existing ideas.

item.title: Plaqueboymax vs Zoe Spencer controversy explained as streamer responds to homophobic F-slurs
item.description: Recent revelations of inappropriate Discord messages from Zoe Spencer aimed at Plaqueboymax have ignited discussions online. While some viewers critique or troll him, Plaqueboymax maintains his composure, asserting he won’t escalate the situation. This calm reaction has drawn mixed reactions, and notable creator Wardrobe has opted to unfollow Zoe amidst the ongoing controversy that continues to trend on social platforms.

item.title: 11 police personnel, 15 militants killed in overnight attack in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
item.description: A major militant attack occurred overnight on a police post in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. Eleven police personnel and fifteen attackers died during the fierce exchange of gunfire. The Khazina police post in Hangu district was the target of this significant assault. Security forces fought back, killing the militants and repelling the attack. This incident highlights the ongoing rise in militant violence in the region.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: The last woolly mammoths survived for 6,000 years after the Ice Age. In 2024, scientists challenged the idea that inbreeding caused their extinction
item.description: Recent genetic studies have revised the understanding of woolly mammoth extinction. These ancient DNA analyses suggest inbreeding alone did not cause their demise. The last mammoths on Wrangel Island survived for millennia despite genetic isolation. A sudden event, not gradual genetic decline, likely ended their final chapter. This research offers insights for modern endangered species conservation efforts.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: How a giant iceberg reached Iowa for Saudi Arabia's freshwater dream
item.description: A 1977 conference in Iowa explored transporting large icebergs for water. Saudi Arabia backed this event, seeking alternatives to desalination. An Alaskan iceberg was transported to Iowa for delegates to inspect. This unusual demonstration aimed to prove the concept's feasibility. The grand plan to tow Antarctic icebergs never fully materialized.

item.title: Hidden deep within the Swiss Alps, this structure was built with 60,000 stone slabs to disappear into the mountain and is now considered one of the greatest works of modern architecture
item.description: Therme Vals situated in the Swiss Alps, was designed by Peter Zumthor in 1996. This structure hides within the rugged mountain landscape, using 60,000 local stone slabs. Visitors experience a cave-like atmosphere through dark passages and varied stone textures. This design respects the mountain ecosystem while providing a unique human experience.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is Pakistan facilitating Chinese missile shipments to Iran? Islamabad responds
item.description: Pakistan's military has strongly denied reports of facilitating Chinese weapons transit to Iran. These claims emerged amid ongoing tensions between Iran and the United States. The Pakistani army dismissed all such speculations as baseless and untrue. This situation highlights Pakistan's careful balancing act between China and Washington. The denial comes after reports suggested Iran would receive air defense systems soon.

item.title: Getting 'carried away' again? Musk's million-dollar plan to rescue Trump in mid-elections
item.description: Elon Musk is reviving his political action committee, America PAC, for the 2026 elections. This group previously spent over $260 million to support Donald Trump's 2024 campaign. America PAC will now focus on increasing Republican voter turnout through various outreach methods. The organization plans to collaborate with other Republican groups to boost their efforts. Musk's involvement signals a significant financial push for the GOP's midterm goals.
item.dc:creator: Shivanghi Payal

item.title: Candace Owens drops unseen Charlie Kirk video, Alex Jones claims assassination story is ‘100% dead’
item.description: Candace Owens has released new rooftop footage that she says raises questions about whether Tyler Robinson was the person who shot Charlie Kirk. Alex Jones backed her claims, arguing the video contradicts the official case against Robinson. However, authorities still identify Robinson as the accused, and a judge has not yet ruled on whether the case will move to trial.
